data.one_liner: Responsive helper widget for fluid layout based on minimum width and proportional space division.
data.what_it_does: The package provides Fluid and Fluidable widgets to arrange children horizontally with proportional division of available width. If children cannot fit on one line due to minimum width constraints, they wrap to a new line automatically.
use_when: You need responsive forms that adapt to changing width constraints.
You want children to wrap to new lines when space runs out while keeping proportional sizing.
avoid_when: You need complex breakpoint-based page layouts instead of simple wrapping container items.
You are looking for a complete adaptive UI design framework.
strengths: Handles wrapping and proportional width distribution based on minimum widths.
Supports custom horizontal spacing and vertical line spacing.
weaknesses: Limited documentation on advanced properties beyond basic fluid factors.
Does not replace comprehensive breakpoint or screen-size responsive frameworks.

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive set of tools for scaling and adapting layouts across different screen sizes.

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers builder widgets targeting specific screen breakpoints (mobile, tablet, desktop).

data.minimal_example:
Fluid(
  children: [
    Fluidable(
      fluid: 1,
      minWidth: 200,
      child: Placeholder(),
    ),
    Fluidable(
      fluid: 1,
      minWidth: 200,
      child: Placeholder(),
    ),
  ],
)
